notes.subject: נקבי
notes.rationale: 'Ol i makim nem bilong ol' (named/designated) o 'ol i klia long lukluk' (distinguished); KJV 'named chief', JPS 'notable men'.

notes.subject: ובאו להם
notes.rationale: 'Na ol i kam long ol' — em i haus Yisrael i kam long ol man namba wan, o ol man bilong Yisrael ol yet i kam? Ol tanima i no wankain.

notes.subject: ol i slip gut long Tsiyon
notes.rationale: Amos i toktok long ol lidya bilong Yisrael na Yuda.

translation: Belhevi i stap long ol i slip gut long Tsiyon, na long ol i strongbel long maunten bilong Shomron — ol man ol i givim nem bilong ol, namba wan bilong olgeta lain — na ol man bilong haus Yisrael i kam long ol.

tokens.gloss: ol man ol i givim nem bilong ol
